intro: ClinicMind now reaches beyond the clinic. Here's what's new, for patients and for doctors.
alerts: First, Auto Alerts. One check goes through every patient, and reminders go out by WhatsApp or SMS on their own. In this demo, delivery is simulated.
alerts_result: Appointments, overdue tests and missed checkups are all covered. If a patient only agreed to SMS, it uses SMS. If they said no, nothing is sent.
approve: For more sensitive messages, the clinic can choose to approve first. This medicine reminder goes out with one click.
qr: Every patient gets a QR code, printed on their prescription. They scan it, enter their birth year, and their own health page opens on their phone.
portal: Everything is in simple words, and one tap switches it to Urdu.
listen: For patients who can't read, it can also read their medicine instructions aloud.
reports: Patients can see their own results over time, what each test means, and the original report. When a result is outside the usual range, it tells them to ask their doctor.
medicine: They tick each dose as they take it, so the doctor can see what the patient reports at home.
reading: They can log their blood pressure too. If a reading crosses the clinic's limit, the patient is told what to do, and the doctor is alerted at once.
doctor_alert: Back at the clinic, the alert is already waiting.
previsit: Before the visit, patients can tell the doctor what's wrong, and ask a question.
checkin: When they arrive, there's no need to queue at the desk. One tap checks them in, and they see their token and about how long they'll wait.
tv: The waiting room screen updates by itself, showing first names only for privacy. When the doctor calls the next patient, it changes straight away.
emergency: The emergency card is a QR code that shows allergies, conditions and medicines to any doctor who needs them.
share: Need a second opinion? A private link shares the record for forty-eight hours, then ends by itself.
access: And patients can see exactly who opened their record.
pulse: Finally, Clinic Pulse shows the doctor the whole clinic at a glance.
close: ClinicMind. Better care between visits, for patients and for doctors.
